data.summary: ESG and sustainability professional with 13+ years of overall professional experience. Proven expertise in project management, stakeholder engagement, and client relationship management, with a strong foundation across sustainability/ESG reporting, ESG due diligence, double materiality assessments, GHG accounting, and global standards compliance (GRI, BRSR, ESRS, IFRS, SASB, TCFD). Cross-sector exposure spanning financial services, media, heavy machinery, manufacturing, FMCG, power, and technology. Adept at translating regulatory requirements and global frameworks into actionable ESG strategies and audit-ready disclosures, equally suited to advisory/assurance engagements and in-house sustainability functions. Skilled at delivering high-impact ESG and risk briefings to C-suite leaders and Operating Committees to align corporate strategy. Committed to aligning business strategy with sustainability goals through rigorous, high-quality ESG reporting.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Intertek India Manager, ESG
Jan 2026 - Present
Leading the development of sustainability and ESG reports for clients across sectors, in line with global reporting standards including GRI, ESRS, IFRS, SASB and TCFD.
Driving BRSR development in accordance with SEBI guidelines and supporting clients on ESG strategy and roadmap formulation.
Leading materiality assessments through peer benchmarking and stakeholder engagement to shape tailored ESG strategies.
Overseeing climate risk assessments and scenario analysis for international clients, including Singapore-based engagements.
Managing reasonable and limited assurance services on ESG parameters of BRSR and Sustainability Reports (aligned to GRI, ESRS, IFRS and SASB), as per AA1000 and ISAE 3000 (Revised) standards.
Formulating and presenting executive briefings to C-suite stakeholders and Operating Committees, driving consensus on strategic priorities and ESG regulatory findings.
Providing advisory services, including ESG policy gap analysis, ESG due diligence and regulatory compliance reviews, across client engagements.
Managing GHG Inventorization (Scope 1, 2 & 3) and Emission Avoidance (Scope 4) assurance engagements based on the Avoided Emissions Framework (AEF).
Leading engagement planning, scoping, budgeting and resourcing across multiple concurrent ESG advisory and assurance assignments.
Priyanka Agrawal
Grant Thornton Bharat LLP Assistant Manager, ESG
May 2023 - Jan 2026
Spearheaded development of sustainability/ESG reports for clients across sectors, aligned to GRI, ESRS, IFRS, SASB and TCFD; developed BRSR in accordance with SEBI guidelines.
Developed ESG strategies and roadmaps across diverse sectors and led double materiality assessments.
Conducted climate risk assessments and scenario analysis for Singapore-based clients. • Delivered advisory services, including gap analysis and policy reviews, to ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulatory requirements.
Delivered reasonable and limited assurance services on ESG parameters of BRSR and Sustainability Reports (aligned to GRI, ESRS, IFRS and SASB), as per AA1000 and ISAE 3000 (Revised) standards.
Formulated and delivered high-impact presentations to C-suite executives and Operating Committees, driving alignment on core strategy and key risk/ESG findings.
Provided assurance on Emission Avoidance (Scope 4) for various products based on the Avoided Emissions Framework (AEF).
Managed post-grant assessments for CSR programs in sectors such as healthcare and education, conducting stakeholder surveys and reporting on program outcomes and impact.
The State Trading Corporation of India Ltd., New Delhi Manager, Marketing
Oct 2010 - Dec 2020
Assisted the Director, Ministry of Commerce, in formulating the National Offset Policy, ensuring alignment with international trade guidelines and India’s economic vision.
Managed monitoring and evaluation of offset activities for foreign suppliers, ensuring adherence to government regulations and compliance protocols.
Directed the development and implementation of a digital e-portal system for the Counter Trade/Offsets Division, enhancing operational efficiency.
Led communication and reporting on the offset program to the Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Civil Aviation and Ministry of Defence.
Represented the organisation before investigating agencies, including the CBI, Enforcement Directorate and Government Audit Party.
Appointed Chief Information Officer and member of the Internal Complaints Committee under the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act (2013), overseeing investigations and ensuring resolution with due diligence.
